title: Associations of Ultra-Processed Food Intake with the Incidence of Cardiometabolic and Mental Health Outcomes Go Beyond Specific Subgroups-The Brazilian Longitudinal Study of Adult Health.
authors: Canhada SL, Vigo Á, Giatti L, Fonseca MJ, Lopes LJ, Cardoso LO, Monteiro CA, Schmidt MI, Duncan BB.
